Name: Garden Hedge
Author: ohrabbit
Description:
[center]I think it will be nice too if we can make our own hedge maze just like spirit festival in the farm, so for a couple hours tweaking here and there, here it is!!
The hedge sprite is not originally mine, it's Chucklefish original from spirit festival maze with some adjustment, like size, because i think the festival hedge is too big.
You can craft this from wood fence since i think mid game people will switch wood fence to hardwood fence anyway.
Also since it replaced wood fence, it needs to be repaired sometimes. If you use SMAPI, there's a durable fence mod that makes fence unbroken. (Or just have a husband or wife that help you fix it! lol)
Since i'm not expert at modding i leave the wood fence craft icon and the description unchanged.


[b]How to Install:[/b]
Just copy and replace the Fence1.xnb file in your Content\LooseSprites directory
Don't forget to back up the original file! [img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]

[b]Update:
[/b]27/03. Smaller hedge now available![/center]
